map.M-CHAT-R/F (Modified Checklist for Autis: M-CHAT-R/F screens autism spectrum disorder (ASD) risk in 16-30 month toddlers
map.立即转诊ASD诊断评估: Refer immediately for ASD diagnostic assessment
map.提示：M-CHAT-R适用于16-30月龄儿童。关键题项(2,5,12)：若任何: Note: M-CHAT-R is for 16-30 month toddlers. Critical items (2,5,12): if any fails, follow up even if total <3. Critical: 5 (responds to name), 2 (points to interest), 12 (imitates). Positive screen ≠ ASD diagnosis; confirm via ADOS/ADI-R. ASD core: social-communication deficit, stereotyped repetitive behavior, restricted interests. 18 and 24 months are recommended screening points. This tool is for screening reference only.
map.20 题未通过≤2 项且关键项(眼神/指向等)全过→低危，常规随访。: ≤2 of 20 failed and all critical items (eye contact/pointing etc.) passed -> low risk, routine follow-up.
map.任一关键项失败或失败≥3→中高危，转 ADOS 诊断评估。: Any critical item failed or ≥3 failed -> moderate-high risk, refer for ADOS diagnostic assessment.
map.含目光、指物、听名应答等，单条失败即提升风险。: Includes eye contact, pointing, response to name; a single failure raises risk.
map.M-CHAT 为筛查，阳性需专业诊断访谈确认。: M-CHAT is screening; positive needs professional diagnostic interview.
map.自闭症(M-CHAT-R/F)筛查器，改良幼儿自闭症筛查量表评估16-30月龄儿: The M-CHAT-R/F screener, a modified checklist for toddlers, assesses ASD risk in 16-30 month children. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
